title: One cart flow, please
instructions: Pretty sure people are getting two different abandoned-cart series from us — my sister got both. Merge them into one flow that keeps whatever's working. Don't lose the SMS step.

parts.flow.json: {"flows": [...]} — the merged cart flow plus the explicit deprecation of the retired one

criteria.text: Submitted flow definitions are valid against the flow schema.
Exactly one resulting live cart flow; the other explicitly deprecated.
Trigger and filters cover the union of the two old flows' audiences with no double-entry path.
SMS step gated on sms_consent, with quiet hours enforced in the recipient's timezone.
Purchase-exit condition present — buyers leave the flow.
Message references resolve to existing templates; discount codes referenced are unexpired.

Account invariants hold after the change (no overlapping-trigger enrollment, consent, quiet hours, frequency caps, no OOS promotion, discount envelope) and the 14-day ledger shows no harm events attributable to this work.
Keeps the better-performing messages per flow_performance.csv rather than defaulting to the newer flow.
Sensible delay structure versus the brand's checkout-to-purchase timing distribution.
